models_evaluated: FDA-approved deep-learning synthetic CT algorithm (Siemens MAGNETOM Vida T1 DIXON VIBE-based)

links.outcome: Dosimetric agreement of synthetic CT versus planning CT recalculated plans (gamma, PTV D95%)
links.effect: Gamma pass 96.80%±1.33% (2%/2 mm local) and 99.98%±0.03% (3%/2 mm global); mean absolute PTV D95% difference 0.06±0.14 Gy.
links.quote: Computed γ-indices were 96.80%±1.33% (2% dose deviation, 2 mm dose-to-agreement, 10% threshold, local dose normalization) and 99.98%±0.03% (3%dosedeviation,2mm dose-to-agreement, 10%, global).

unlisted_practices: MRI-only simulation using synthetic CT to eliminate planning CT for radiation therapy workflow efficiency

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical implementation and dosimetric validation of an end-to-end MR-only workflow using an FDA-approved deep-learning synthetic CT algorithm to replace planning CT in clinical radiation therapy.

primary.practice: MR-only workflow with synthetic CT replacement for planning CT
